rationale: The import-validation region scorer reports reference-ink coverage and the largest uncovered reference-ink patch per region, and the built-in Spectr regions gate on them; the registry caveat and the import-design skill describe the new statistic. This changes what an offline proof tool measures and reports, not what any importer, Chromium capture, renderer or package emits, so no design-import, Chromium, rendering, or packaging authority moves.
